title: R1 arm/wrist reachable workspace and self-collision behaviour

frames.compatibility: Legacy wrist-joint-origin endpoint retained to reproduce schema-1 T002 evidence; current T007 uses the vendor R1-A5 virtual EE offset [0.20, 0, 0] m.

notes: The method record leaves every numeric threshold to this experiment.
position_tolerance_m 0.002 is 2 mm, about 0.35% of the 0.57 m measured arm reach.
damping 0.01 keeps the damped-least-squares step bounded near singular configurations.
posture_tolerance_rad 1e-4 is the settling criterion for the redundant degree of freedom; without it the solver stops on position alone and the solution depends on the seed.
max_joint_step_rad 0.1 bounds one solver iteration. This is a solver step limit, not a robot rate limit; joint rate limiting is out of scope for a static grid sweep and is declared by T003.

Bounds are derived from a measured envelope, not chosen freely: 20,000 random joint samples inside the URDF limits put the left endpoint in x [-0.330, 0.330], y [-0.121, 0.443], z [-0.120, 0.539] with reach up to 0.570 m from the waist.
The grid deliberately extends towards the envelope edge so some targets are unreachable. An unreachable target is a valid recorded result about the workspace boundary, not a failure to hide.
Right-arm y is mirrored because the shoulder-roll range is mirrored between arms.
The R1 USD blocks the head joints when articulation self-collisions are enabled; whether the arm chain is affected the same way is unestablished and is the second question of T002.
The probe is a controlled A/B: the identical target grid is swept twice, changing only enabled_self_collisions, and the achieved joint positions are compared against the commanded ones.
joint_tracking_error_threshold_rad 0.05 separates settling error from mechanical blocking. It is a reporting threshold for the comparison, not an acceptance criterion for the workspace.
settle_steps_per_target is 0.3 s of simulated time at 200 Hz, long enough for the implicit position actuators to settle before the achieved joint positions are read.
The pelvis is pinned so the arm base frame is fixed; the waist joints belong to locomotion and are held at their default.

invalid_if: the runner crashes or any evidence file is missing
the forward kinematics disagrees with the simulator endpoint beyond the declared tolerance
valid_scientific_failure: an unreachable target with a converged solver refusal
a self-collision that prevents a reachable target from being held
